reconciliation_policy.content: Corporate Card Reconciliation Policy v3.2. (1) Every posted charge must match a submitted expense entry within +/- $0.00. (2) Receipts are required for all charges over $25.00. (3) Charges with no matching expense entry are 'unidentified' and must be escalated, not auto-closed. (4) Cardholders receive a missing-receipt notice only after the finance manager reviews and approves the exception list. (5) The controller summary is emailed only after the manager signs off on the reconciliation.

tools.name: retrieve_expense_tracker

tools.description: List and read the submitted receipt files folder to determine which expenses have receipts on file.

tools.name: lookup_cardholder_directory
tools.description: Look up cardholder names, card numbers, and contact email addresses.

tools.name: run_reconciliation_match
tools.description: Match each posted statement charge to a submitted expense entry, flag unmatched/unidentified charges and missing-receipt exceptions.

tools.description: Prepare a reconciliation summary (matched charges, exceptions, unidentified charges) and draft cardholder missing-receipt notices for the user to review.

tools.name: read_reconciliation_policy
